## New
- **Player gestures on the phone:** drag the big player down to put it away, drag the small player up to open it. The player follows your finger
- **Imported playlists become your own:** "Save as playlist" (button on the playlist and in its menu) moves an imported playlist to your playlists, also when its songs come from a platform

## Faster
- **First play:** songs from Spotify, Deezer and YouTube are looked up as soon as they are on screen and when your finger reaches them, so a song you never played starts much sooner

## Fixed
- **Covers:** the big player and playlist pages load the sharpest picture the platform has. Covers of your own files are checked against the file, so a replaced song no longer shows the old picture
- **Small player:** the buttons always sit at the right edge, however short the title is

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script / `musik-update`)
- **Android:** from 1.7.1 on: Settings → Updates → Update now. Older versions: uninstall Musik once, then install the new `Musik.apk`
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates, or `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
